skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-chatgpt-ads-poas-bidding
skill.description: Set up profit or revenue bidding for Lightspeed eCom (C-Series) in ChatGPT Ads using Product Metrics. Check that paid orders send the intended conversion value through the OpenAI Conversions API before switching a campaign.
skill.summary: Use Product Metrics to verify Lightspeed profit events and plan a switch from revenue to profit bidding in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts concern setup documentation or Markdown formatting, with no evidence of system reconnaissance or attempts to override the audit. Confirmed risks include broad order reads, remote tool access, and an unpinned installer. The workflow also permits collecting credentials through the assistant and leaves event scope and consent requirements unclear.

remediation.issue: The skill permits the assistant to request integration credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the exception for collecting keys in chat or passing them to commands. Direct users to enter keys only in the verified app.

remediation.issue: The default destination sends more than the profit signal.
remediation.suggestion: Show event and data categories before enabling delivery. Require approval for the selected property and pixel, and offer the smallest supported event scope.

remediation.issue: The references do not give a consistent explanation of consent requirements.
remediation.suggestion: Document the required consent for each event and field. Verify that test orders behave as documented when shoppers decline consent.

remediation.issue: Test order checks can retrieve unrelated customer order records.
remediation.suggestion: Use a known test order in a user-confirmed storefront. Return only delivery status and the conversion value needed for verification.

remediation.issue: The remote tool fallback can execute operations through a vendor endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Use only a user-approved connector and verify its endpoint and account. Require approval before writes or disclosure of sensitive data.

remediation.issue: The installer does not pin the runner or the skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Publish a reviewed installer version and an immutable source revision. Keep installation separate from setup and require the user to approve it.

semantic_findings.title: Credential Collection Through the Assistant
semantic_findings.description: The skill lets the assistant request integration keys and pass them to a command. This may expose credentials in chat or tool records.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception explicitly permits collecting integration keys from the user. Both connection guides instead require keeping keys out of chat.

semantic_findings.title: Default Event Delivery Exceeds the Bidding Task
semantic_findings.description: The fallback setup leaves delivery enabled and sends events beyond profit bidding. This can share order identifiers and shopper matching data before the merchant reviews the scope.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The reference states which data the destination sends by default. The setup does not require a separate review of those categories before enabling delivery.

semantic_findings.title: Unclear Consent Requirements for Profit Events
semantic_findings.description: One guide says nothing is sent without marketing consent. The profit guide says an event can be sent without ad personalisation consent, marked as opted out.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guides do not reconcile marketing, analytics, and ad personalisation requirements. This is a documentation gap, not evidence that the service bypasses consent.

content.user_title: Set Up Profit Bidding for Lightspeed in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A campaign can meet its revenue target while losing money after product costs, payment fees, and shipping. Use Product Metrics to verify profit conversions and plan a campaign switch.
actual_capabilities: Check store tracking and destination setup through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP connector.
Guide the merchant through connecting Lightspeed and an existing ChatGPT Ads pixel.
Explain where product costs come from and how to configure payment fees and fallback costs.
Guide a paid test order and check whether the profit conversion reaches ChatGPT Ads.
Explain how to select a profit or revenue conversion in Ads Manager and estimate a starting target.
limitations: Requires Lightspeed eCom C-Series on the EU or US cluster, a proxied Cloudflare domain, and Product Metrics Pro.
The merchant must create the conversion and choose the campaign's optimisation event in Ads Manager.
Orders with unknown costs send revenue only. Loss-making orders are reported with a profit value of zero.
Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds do not revise events already sent to ChatGPT Ads.

use_cases.title: Assess a Move to Profit Bidding
use_cases.description: Find out whether a campaign that meets its revenue target covers order costs and ad spend.

use_cases.title: Verify Conversion Delivery
use_cases.description: Check the store connection, pixel, and paid test order before the advertising team changes a campaign.

use_cases.title: Plan a Single-Campaign Test
use_cases.description: Use measured profit on ad spend to propose a starting target and list the checks to make after launch.

prompt_templates.title: Understand POAS
prompt_templates.scenario: You are comparing profit and revenue bidding for the first time.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the difference between POAS and ROAS for my Lightspeed store. Use one example with revenue, order costs, and ad spend.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a Product Metrics property and want to know what is missing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check tracking for my confirmed Lightspeed property. Report the remaining setup steps without changing settings or asking me for credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Profit Event
prompt_templates.scenario: You placed a paid test order after configuring costs and consent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check delivery for this test order only. Tell me whether the profit event arrived and what to review if it did not.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Campaign Switch
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a verified profit conversion and measured POAS.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my measured POAS to propose a starting target for one campaign. List the manual Ads Manager steps and leave the campaign unchanged.

output_examples.input: My test order arrived as a purchase, but I see no profit conversion. What should I check?
output: The purchase can arrive without a profit value when one or more costs are unknown.
Check the product cost and configured payment fees, then place a new paid test order after verifying consent.

output_examples.input: My measured POAS is 1.5. What target should I test?
output: A 150% target matches your measured POAS. On a profit signal, 100% is break-even after ad spend.
Test the target on one campaign after confirming the profit conversion in Ads Manager.

best_practices: Enter credentials only in the verified app, and confirm the property and pixel before enabling delivery.
Review the destination's event and consent settings before validating a paid test order.
Pilot the profit conversion on one campaign and revisit the target after a few weeks.
anti_patterns: Do not share API keys or raw customer order data in chat.
Do not switch campaigns before confirming that a test order produced the intended profit event.
Do not reuse a revenue target unchanged when switching a campaign to profit bidding.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores are supported?
faq.answer: Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe or United States cluster.

faq.question: Can I keep bidding on revenue?
faq.answer: Yes. The standard paid order event carries revenue and does not need a separate custom conversion.

faq.question: Where does the profit value come from?
faq.answer: Product Metrics uses Lightspeed line costs and configured additional costs, including payment fees. It needs complete costs to send a profit value.

faq.question: Who changes the campaign in Ads Manager?
faq.answer: You create the profit conversion and select it in the campaign. The skill guides you through the steps without making that change.

faq.question: Will past orders or later refunds update ChatGPT Ads?
faq.answer: No. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds do not update conversion events that were already sent.

faq.question: Which consent settings should I check?
faq.answer: Confirm your banner and verify the destination's consent requirements before enabling delivery. Test both accepted and declined consent.
